description.tr: 1513 dünya haritası Amerika'ları gösteren en eski hayatta kalan haritalardan biridir — Kolomb'un kullandığı artık kayıp bir harita dahil 20+ kaynaktan çizildi || 1513 Pîrî Reis harita parçası (hayatta kalan batı üçte biri), Güney Amerika kıyısını yalnızca Avrupa kaynaklarından mümkün olmayan doğrulukla göstermesi, 20+ kaynağını açıkça belirtmesi ile dikkat çekicidir. || [Tarih notu] Harita 1929'da Topkapı Sarayı'nda yeniden keşfedildi. McIntosh (2000) Hapgood/Antarktika teorilerini çürütürken haritanın gerçek kartografik önemini doğruladı.
description.en: His 1513 world map is one of the oldest surviving maps showing the Americas — drawn from 20+ sources including a now-lost map used by Columbus. The Kitab-ı Bahriye is the most comprehensive Mediterranean navigational atlas of its era || The 1513 Piri Reis map fragment (surviving western third) is remarkable for several reasons: it shows the South American coast with accuracy impossible from European sources alone, it explicitly cites its 20+ sources (including 'a map by the Genoese infidel called Colombo'), and some scholars have argued it shows Antarctic coastlines — though this is contested. The Kitab-ı Bahriye (219 maps, 1521/1526 editions) remained the standard Mediterranean pilot guide for Ottoman navigators for two centuries. || [Historiographical note] The map was rediscovered in 1929 at Topkapı Palace. Kahle (1933) first published it. McIntosh's Piri Reis Map of 1513 (2000) provided the most thorough analysis, debunking the Hapgood/Antarctic theories while confirming the map's genuine cartographic significance.
description.ar: خريطته عام ١٥١٣ من أقدم الخرائط الباقية التي تُظهر الأمريكتين || خريطة بيري ريس ١٥١٣ تُظهر الساحل الأمريكي الجنوبي بدقة تفوق المصادر الأوروبية وحدها. كتاب البحرية (٢١٩ خريطة) بقي دليل الملاحة المعياري لقرنين
